Both get me to the saved page, so either one works. The difference: this version opens the page in the same tab, so I use the browser's back button to get back to my list, whereas Approach 1 left my bookmark list sitting in its own tab while the page opened separately.

For the finished app I'd prefer Approach 1 — opening the page separately and leaving my list waiting where it was. When I'm going through my bookmarks I often want to open one, look at it, and come straight back to keep browsing, so not losing my place in the list is the nicer experience. Please go with that one.
